Khud ko uthane ke liye, kisi aur ko uthaao.
Jitni mehnat karo, utni luck milti hai.
Tumhara mind tumhara sabse bada asset hai.
Tum occasion tak nahi uthte; tum apne level pe girte ho.
Pockets mein haath rakhke ladder nahi chadhta.
Tumhara mind bohot powerful hai.
"Time waste nahi. Wise jiyo, great bano."
"Grit: long-term goals ke liye passion aur perseverance."
"Dreams tabhi kaam karti jab tum karte."
Failures ko define mat hone do.
Sabse achha badla bada safalta hai.
